lead: A `-p nvs-stdlib` test can hand a `Core` member a compiled class, and the installation point is named for something else.
body: `Ctx::class_desc`, the one route from a native member to a program's class, reads the table through `Ctx::set_runtime_error_class`'s handle and nothing else, so a dispatch test installs an `ErrorClass::new(Rc::new(table), id)` over an unrelated class. The row is `MethodRow { arity }` excluding the receiver and slot 0 is the called class as a `Value::class_desc`; `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/command.rs`'s `dispatching` is the shape.
